engine/soyeht-engine/src/test_hooks.rs::: Installed by the soyeht-engine-test program (engine/soyeht-engine/tests/test-engine/program.rs), which is built only with the test-hooks feature and is not production code (ADR 0091).
Comparability rule of ADR 0069 for evaluation reports; the experiment tooling that compares two reports is not built yet.
engine/soyeht-pane-state/src/metrics.rs:: Candidate ranking rule of ADR 0069 (coverage within five percentage points); the experiment tooling that ranks candidates is not built yet.
engine/soyeht-store/src/editor.rs::activ: Read-back of persisted replacements, used by the store and engine integration tests to check durability; no production reader.
engine/soyeht-store/src/usage.rs::usage_: Read-back of one persisted usage reading, used by the store and engine tests; production reads them all through usage_readings.
engine/soyeht-store/src/web.rs::web_sess: Read-back of persisted session grants, used by the store tests to check durability; no production reader.
engine/soyeht-store/src/writing.rs::writ: Read-back of persisted sidecar versions, used by the store tests to check retention; no production reader.
apps/android/core/src/core.rs::choose_us: The hook for choosing, while the app runs, the provider whose meter reads a harness (ADR 0141). Its first caller is the OpenCode meter that follows the provider OpenCode is set to (ADR 0133); until then the contract's rule answers.
